title: Darren Rizzi: Special teams coaches want NFL to change rule for holders on kickoffs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Darren Rizzi: Special teams coaches want NFL to change rule for holders on kickoffs
sources.description: Broncos special teams coach Darren Rizzi says his colleagues around the league almost all agree that holders should be allowed on kickoffs only if the wind is blowing the ball off the tee, and not to give the kicking team an advantage by placing the ball at an unusual angle.
